CREATE.query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient (patient_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY, first_name TEXT NOT NULL, last_name TEXT NOT NULL, acuity INTEGER NOT NULL, phn int UNIQUE, phase_step_id INTEGER NOT NULL, email TEXT, ssn TEXT, title TEXT, country TEXT, dob DATETIME, admitted DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, police_reports INTEGER DEFAULT 0, assessments INTEGER DEFAULT 0, status TEXT, path TEXT, street_address TEXT, city TEXT, province TEXT, postal_code TEXT, phone TEXT, contact_name TEXT, relation TEXT, contact_phone TEXT, family_doctor_name TEXT, family_doctor_phone TEXT, pharmacy_name TEXT, pharmacy_phone TEXT, pharmacy_fax TEXT, narrative_hint TEXT, abo_type INTEGER, rh_factor INTEGER, last_update DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);
CREATE INDEX idx_patient_name ON patient(last_name, first_name);
CREATE INDEX idx_patient_workflow ON patient(status, acuity, last_update);
CREATE INDEX idx_patient_phn ON patient(phn);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_metrics (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, reading_id int NOT NULL, metric_type TEXT NOT NULL, metric_value REAL NOT NULL, recorded_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, is_patient_metric BOOL, FOREIGN KEY(patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS provider (provider_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, first_name TEXT NOT NULL, last_name TEXT NOT NULL,  avatar BLOB, website TEXT, gender TEXT, position TEXT, is_specialist INTEGER DEFAULT 0, pager TEXT, city TEXT, street TEXT, pr_st TEXT, code TEXT, country TEXT, accreditations TEXT, specializations TEXT, facility TEXT, office_phone TEXT, office_email TEXT, personal_phone TEXT, personal_email TEXT, started_seeing DATETIME, stopped_seeing DATETIME, purpose TEXT, cancellation_policy TEXT, cancellation_notice_hours INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS device (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, purpose TEXT, started_using DATETIME, stopped_using DATETIME, measures INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(measures) REFERENCES metric(id), FOREIGN KEY(patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS metric (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, paired INTEGER DEFAULT 0, pair_id INTEGER, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, purpose TEXT, is_integer INTEGER, symbol TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, safe_upper_limit REAL NOT NULL, safe_lower_limit REAL NOT NULL, healthy_upper_limit REAL NOT NULL, healthy_lower_limit REAL NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS unit_of_measure (name TEXT NOT NULL, symbol TEXT, is_metric BOOL, conversion_functions TEXT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS metric_combination (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, first_metric_id INT NOT NULL, second_metric_id INT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, symbol TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_metric_tracking (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, metric_id INT NOT NULL, on_dashboard INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, source TEXT, source_detail TEXT, started_tracking DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, stopped_tracking DATETIME, reason TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid), FOREIGN KEY(metric_id) REFERENCES metric(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_metric (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, metric_id INTEGER NOT NULL, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, value REAL NOT NULL, measured DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, recorded DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, unit_of_measure TEXT NOT NULL, is_metric BOOL NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY(metric_id) REFERENCES metric(id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_event (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, occurs DATETIME, recurs BOOL, recurrence TEXT, terminates DATETIME, notify BOOL, notify_lead REAL, notify_units TEXT, location TEXT, occurred BOOL, actual_occurrence DATETIME);
CREATE INDEX idx_patient_event_time ON patient_event(occurred);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_vaccination (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, protection TEXT, received INTEGER, years_ago INTEGER, next_due DATETIME, patient_uuid TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS test_catalog (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, description TEXT, category TEXT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_test (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT, last_done DATETIME, next_due DATETIME, notes TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE patient_mood (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, mood INTEGER NOT NULL, reason TEXT, start_date TEXT NOT NULL, end_date TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE); CREATE INDEX idx_patient_mood_uuid ON patient_mood(patient_uuid);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS datasheet (set_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, version TEXT, rxcui TEXT, brand_name TEXT, generic_name TEXT, classes TEXT, raw_json_blob TEXT, last_synced_at TEXT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS assessment (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, column_headers TEXT,instructions TEXT, timeframe TEXT );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS question (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, assessment_id TEXT NOT NULL, cluster TEXT, cluster_name TEXT, question_text TEXT, description TEXT, question_type TEXT, max_score INTEGER, depends_on TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (assessment_id) REFERENCES assessment(id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS medication (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, patient_uuid TEXT, name TEXT, set_id TEXT, dose TEXT, freq TEXT, reminder_time TEXT, type TEXT, shape TEXT, color TEXT, started_taking DATETIME, stopped_taking DATETIME, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, has_local_datasheet int NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid), FOREIGN KEY (set_id) REFERENCES datasheet(set_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT);
CREATE INDEX idx_medication_patient_started ON medication(patient_uuid, started_taking);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS medication_dose_log (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, medication_id TEXT NOT NULL, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, scheduled_for DATETIME NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, responded_at DATETIME, notes TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (medication_id) REFERENCES medication(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE);
CREATE INDEX idx_dose_log_patient_time ON medication_dose_log(patient_uuid, scheduled_for);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS test_completion_log (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT, completed_on DATETIME NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE);
CREATE INDEX idx_test_completion_patient_time ON test_completion_log(patient_uuid, completed_on);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_diary_entry (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, entry_date TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, UNIQUE(patient_uuid, entry_date), FOREIGN KEY (patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE);
CREATE INDEX idx_diary_patient_date ON patient_diary_entry(patient_uuid, entry_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_dose_log_medication_time ON medication_dose_log(medication_id, scheduled_for);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS medication_change_log (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, medication_id TEXT NOT NULL, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, previous_dose TEXT, new_dose TEXT, previous_freq TEXT, new_freq TEXT, reason TEXT NOT NULL, changed_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (medication_id) REFERENCES medication(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE);
CREATE INDEX idx_medication_change_log_medication_time ON medication_change_log(medication_id, changed_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_medication_change_log_patient_time ON medication_change_log(patient_uuid, changed_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS medication_reminder_preference (medication_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, chime_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, text_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, email_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, wearable_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, wearable_mode TEXT, lead_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (medication_id) REFERENCES medication(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS metric_reminder_preference (metric_id INTEGER NOT NULL, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, chime_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, text_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, email_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, wearable_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, wearable_mode TEXT, cadence TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'daily', reminder_time TEXT, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (metric_id, patient_uuid), FOREIGN KEY (metric_id) REFERENCES metric(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_metric_threshold (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, metric_id INTEGER NOT NULL, danger_low REAL, danger_high REAL, healthy_low REAL, healthy_high REAL, set_by TEXT, set_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, active INTEGER DEFAULT 1, FOREIGN KEY (patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (metric_id) REFERENCES metric(id) ON DELETE CASCADE);
CREATE INDEX idx_threshold_patient_metric ON patient_metric_threshold(patient_uuid, metric_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_metric_target (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, metric_id INTEGER NOT NULL, target_value REAL NOT NULL, direction INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, set_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, active INTEGER DEFAULT 1, FOREIGN KEY (patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (metric_id) REFERENCES metric(id) ON DELETE CASCADE);
CREATE INDEX idx_target_patient_metric ON patient_metric_target(patient_uuid, metric_id);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS condition (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT UNIQUE, category TEXT, treatment TEXT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS completed_assessment ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, assessment_id TEXT NOT NULL, patient_id TEXT NOT NULL, date_started DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, complete INTEGER DEFAULT 0, date_completed DATETIME, last_modified DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (assessment_id) REFERENCES assessment(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY (patient_id) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid) ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS completed_question ( completed_assessment_id TEXT NOT NULL, question_id TEXT NOT NULL, answer TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (completed_assessment_id, question_id), FOREIGN KEY (completed_assessment_id) REFERENCES completed_assessment(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (question_id) REFERENCES question(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE patient_condition (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, patient_uuid TEXT, condition_id int, treatment_notes TEXT, status INTEGER DEFAULT 0, onset DATETIME, status_date DATETIME, duration_estimate_value INTEGER, duration_estimate_unit INTEGER, treatment_reviewed_at DATETIME, recorded_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient (patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (condition_id) REFERENCES condition (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supply (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT UNIQUE, category TEXT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS condition_supply (condition_id INTEGER NOT NULL, supply_id INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (condition_id, supply_id), FOREIGN KEY (condition_id) REFERENCES condition (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (supply_id) REFERENCES supply (id) ON DELETE CASCADE);
CREATE INDEX idx_condition_supply_condition ON condition_supply(condition_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_supply (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT, quantity_on_hand INTEGER DEFAULT 0, reorder_threshold INTEGER DEFAULT 5, linked_medication_id TEXT, added_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient (patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (linked_medication_id) REFERENCES medication (id) ON DELETE SET NULL);
CREATE INDEX idx_patient_supply_patient ON patient_supply(patient_uuid);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vision_prescription (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, provider_uuid TEXT, type INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, od_sphere REAL, od_cylinder REAL, od_axis INTEGER, od_add REAL, os_sphere REAL, os_cylinder REAL, os_axis INTEGER, os_add REAL, pd REAL, base_curve REAL, diameter REAL, issued_date DATETIME, expiry_date DATETIME, notes TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient (patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (provider_uuid) REFERENCES provider (provider_uuid) ON DELETE SET NULL);
CREATE INDEX idx_vision_prescription_patient ON vision_prescription(patient_uuid);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS allergen (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT UNIQUE, category TEXT, description TEXT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patient_allergy (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, allergen_id INTEGER NOT NULL, severity INTEGER DEFAULT 0, reaction TEXT, recorded_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient (patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (allergen_id) REFERENCES allergen (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT);
CREATE INDEX idx_patient_allergy_patient ON patient_allergy(patient_uuid);

CREATE TABLE observations (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, patient_uuid TEXT, author_name TEXT, author_role TEXT, content TEXT, time_stamp DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient (patient_uuid));

CREATE TABLE activity (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, started DATETIME, ended DATETIME, target REAL, achieved_target DATETIME, schedule BOOL, notify BOOL, doctor_ordered BOOL);
CREATE TABLE patient_activity (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, performed DATETIME, scheduled DATETIME, notes TEXT, performance REAL, unit_of_measure TEXT);

CREATE TABLE patient_action (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,  patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL,  action_uuid TEXT NOT NULL,  actor_uuid TEXT NOT NULL,  witness_uuid TEXT,  occurred INTEGER NOT NULL,  action_type INTEGER, notes TEXT,  FOREIGN KEY (action_uuid) REFERENCES action(id)  );
CREATE INDEX idx_patient_action_time ON patient_action(patient_uuid,  occurred);

CREATE TABLE patient_transfer (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,  patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL,  requested_by_uuid TEXT NOT NULL,  requesting_team TEXT,  grantor_uuid TEXT,  from_ward TEXT,  to_ward TEXT,  requested INTEGER NOT NULL,  disposed_at INTEGER,  status INTEGER,  denial INTEGER, transferred_at INTEGER,  notes TEXT  );
CREATE INDEX idx_patient_transfer_time ON patient_transfer(patient_uuid,  requested);

CREATE TABLE appointment (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, patient_uuid TEXT, provider_uuid TEXT, location_name TEXT, scheduled_for DATETIME NOT NULL, appointment_update_url TEXT, appointment_url TEXT, reason TEXT, notes TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled', street TEXT, city TEXT, pr_st TEXT, country TEXT, code TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE );
CREATE INDEX idx_appointment_scheduled_for ON appointment(scheduled_for);

CREATE TABLE acuity_log (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL,acuity_level INTEGER NOT NULL, encounter_id TEXT, rationale TEXT,set_bu TEXT NOT NULL, set_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient (patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE);

CREATE TABLE interaction (interaction_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name_a TEXT NOT NULL, name_b TEXT NOT NULL, rxcui_a TEXT, rxcui_b TEXT , severity TEXT, explanation TEXT, local_datasheet_id TEXT,FOREIGN KEY(rxcui_a) REFERENCES drug_name(rx_norm_id),FOREIGN KEY(rxcui_b) REFERENCES drug_name(rx_norm_id));
CREATE INDEX idx_interaction_pair ON interaction(rxcui_a, rxcui_b);
CREATE INDEX idx_interaction_name_pair ON interaction(name_a, name_b);
CREATE TABLE drug_name ( rx_norm_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE markers ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, dx REAL NOT NULL, dy REAL NOT NULL, zone_map INTEGER NOT NULL, zone_name TEXT NOT NULL, marker_group INTEGER NOT NULL, emoji INTEGER NOT NULL, severity INTEGER, frequency INTEGER, nature INTEGER, care_plan TEXT, dismissal_reason TEXT, descriptions TEXT, improves_when TEXT,  worsens_when TEXT,  interventions_tried TEXT,  recorded INTEGER NOT NULL, resolved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, resolved_at DATETIME, last_checked_at DATETIME);
CREATE INDEX idx_markers_recorded ON markers(recorded);
CREATE INDEX idx_markers_patient_uuid ON markers(patient_uuid);
CREATE INDEX idx_markers_followup ON markers(patient_uuid, resolved, recorded);

CREATE TABLE interaction_acknowledgment (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, medication_a TEXT NOT NULL, medication_b TEXT NOT NULL, acknowledged_at DATETIME NOT NULL, dismissed_at DATETIME, UNIQUE(patient_uuid, medication_a, medication_b));
CREATE INDEX idx_interaction_ack_patient ON interaction_acknowledgment(patient_uuid);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS achievement (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, patient_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT, icon TEXT, earned_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, acknowledged_at DATETIME, FOREIGN KEY (patient_uuid) REFERENCES patient(patient_uuid) ON DELETE CASCADE);
CREATE INDEX idx_achievement_patient ON achievement(patient_uuid);
